recovery_key.label: Recovery key

recovery_key.copy_expired: To copy the recovery key again, show it again from Settings > Security.

recovery.wrong_key: This recovery key does not unlock the data on this device.
settings.title: Settings
security.auto_lock_description: Lock Shell++ after this long without keyboard or mouse input.
security.change_password_description: The new password takes effect immediately.
security.recovery_key_description: Show the current recovery key or replace it with a new one. Both ask for the master password.
security.remember_device_description: Unlock at launch without the master password. Lock and auto-lock still ask for it.
change_password.title: Change master password
change_password.sync_warning: Your other devices will be signed out and will ask for the new password.
recovery_password.text_show: Enter the master password to show the recovery key.
recovery_password.text_reissue: A new recovery key replaces the current one, and the current key stops working. Enter the master password to continue.
recovery_key_dialog.title: Recovery key
recovery_key_dialog.text: Keep this key somewhere safe, away from this device.
recovery_key_dialog.text_new: This is your new recovery key. The previous key no longer works. Keep it somewhere safe, away from this device.
remember_device.title: Remember on this device?
remember_device.text: Shell++ will store a device key in the system keychain and unlock at launch without the master password. Any program running under your user account on this device will be able to unlock your data.
